lesson:
Chromium writes title text set to `color: #000` into a PDF as RGB black, so a cover with CMYK images can still fail preflight; convert the finished PDF with Ghostscript CMYK strategy.
When a print vendor's preflight rejects a PDF for RGB content even though every image has already been converted to CMYK.
